verdicts.reason: A: the 'Happy Easter' lettering is blown up so far that 'Easter' sits right across the bunny, the basket and the sweater, and 'FUN GROUP' sits on top of the bicycle wheels. The bike is also cut off at the bottom edge and the leaf garlands are gone, though 'Happy' is still readable on white and still reads as the headline. B: the shrunken gold headline sits completely on the busy bunny and basket, so it is hard to read, and it collides with the bunny's face. 'FUN GROUP' has moved above the headline, which flips the reading order and lets the small brand line compete as the main focal point. The bike is cropped at the bottom here too, leaving dead white space at the top and a crowded lower half.
